svg.aria-label: Multi-agent order operations assistant: Google ADK agents on Cloud Run
svg.title: Multi-agent order operations assistant: Google ADK agents on Cloud Run
svg.text: Multi-agent order operations assistant: Google ADK agents on Cloud Run

An ADK coordinator with local sub-agents calls remote ADK specialist agents over A2A; every agent is its own Cloud Run service with its own service account, Gemini on Vertex AI and tools via MCP Toolbox

g.data-tip: Prompts that pass Model Armor go to Gemini on Vertex AI; the agent chooses tools or sub-agents from the model's reply

g.title: 5. Prompts that pass Model Armor go to Gemini on Vertex AI; the agent chooses tools or sub-agents from the model's reply

g.data-tip: An operator asks a question in the chat UI; Identity-Aware Proxy authenticates the user

g.title: 1. An operator asks a question in the chat UI; Identity-Aware Proxy authenticates the user

g.data-tip: The UI calls the coordinator's ADK API server with the user's session id; Cloud Run requires an ID token (roles/run.invoker)

g.title: 2. The UI calls the coordinator's ADK API server with the user's session id; Cloud Run requires an ID token (roles/run.invoker)

g.data-tip: The coordinator delegates planning and summarising to local sub-agents running in the same process

g.title: 3. The coordinator delegates planning and summarising to local sub-agents running in the same process

g.data-tip: The coordinator calls the remote inventory agent over the A2A protocol (RemoteA2aAgent), authenticating with a Google ID token

g.title: 6. The coordinator calls the remote inventory agent over the A2A protocol (RemoteA2aAgent), authenticating with a Google ID token

g.data-tip: Specialist agents reach the database only through MCP Toolbox, which holds the connection and the allowed queries
